name: @microsoft/dynamics-365-dataverse
description: Generic Dynamics 365 Dataverse connector for Dataverse Web API records and metadata. Create, read, update, delete, list, and FetchXML-query Dataverse rows; search Dataverse tables; manage relationships; invoke Dataverse actions and functions; transfer file/image column values through Slate attachments; and execute Dataverse $batch requests. This connector targets Dataverse-backed Dynamics 365 environments and does not implement Finance and Operations, Commerce, Business Central, or native webhook registration APIs.
skills: upload and download Dataverse file columns
